what: Markdown to HTML turns plain Markdown text into clean HTML, with a live preview beside your writing. You can copy the HTML, see the source code, or download a complete .html web page or your .md file.
It is handy for writers, bloggers, students and developers: preparing a README, a blog post, documentation, or notes that need to go into a website or email template.

It supports GitHub-flavoured Markdown, including tables, task lists, strikethrough and fenced code blocks. The output is always cleaned, so scripts and other unsafe code are removed. Everything happens in your browser.
uses: Write in Markdown and paste the HTML into a website editor that only accepts HTML.
Check how a README with tables and code blocks will look before you push it.
Draft in Markdown and copy the HTML into your email template.
Download a complete .html file that anyone can open in a browser.
Load the sample to see each feature and how it turns into HTML.
tutorial: Type or paste Markdown into the Markdown box, click Open .md file to load one from your device, or press Load sample to start from an example.
The Preview tab updates as you type, showing headings, lists, tables, task lists, code and quotes as they will look.
Click HTML source to see the generated code. This is exactly what Copy HTML copies.

By default a single line break joins lines into one paragraph, as in standard Markdown. Tick "Treat single line breaks as
" to keep each line separate, like GitHub comments.
Click Copy HTML to put the HTML on your clipboard, ready to paste into a website, CMS or template.
Download .html saves a full web page with a title taken from your first heading and simple styling. Download .md saves your Markdown text.
features: See the formatted result while you type.
Tables with alignment, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks and fenced code blocks.
Scripts, event handlers, javascript: links, iframes, forms and style blocks are removed from both the preview and the output.
Inspect the exact HTML before copying it.
Get a ready-to-open .html document with clean, readable styling.
Load a Markdown file from your device and save your edits back as .md.
Your text is converted in your browser and is not saved or uploaded.

example.title: Worked example: a small table
example.text: You type three lines: | Tool | Free |, then | --- | --- |, then | Regex Tester | Yes |. The preview shows a table with a header row Tool and Free and one row Regex Tester, Yes. The HTML source shows <table>, <thead> with two <th> cells, and <tbody> with two <td> cells. Click Copy HTML and paste it into your website's HTML editor.

tips: Leave a blank line between paragraphs, lists, tables and code blocks so they are recognised.
Put the language after the opening ``` of a code block, like ```js, so the code gets a language class for syntax highlighters.
Write task list items as - [ ] to do and - [x] done.
Use a colon in the table divider row to align columns: :--- left, :---: centre, ---: right.
Start the document with a # heading: it becomes the title and file name of the downloaded page.

Markdown joins lines within a paragraph. Leave a blank line between paragraphs, end a line with two spaces, or tick "Treat single line breaks as
".
A table needs a header row, a divider row like | --- | --- | and a blank line before it.
Only plain text files can be opened, such as .md, .markdown or .txt. Word or PDF files need to be converted to text first.
